import numpy as np import matplotlib as mpl import matplotlib.pyplot as plt from matplotlib.patches import FancyArrowPatch
mpl.rcParams.update({ "font.family": "DejaVu Sans", "mathtext.fontset": "dejavusans", "font.size": 10, "text.color": "#263238", "figure.facecolor": "white", "axes.facecolor": "white", "svg.fonttype": "none", })
blue = "#33658A" teal = "#2A9D8F" ochre = "#D4A72C" ink = "#263238"
N = 4 X = np.array([10, -2 + 2j, -2, -2 - 2j], dtype=complex) X_conj = np.conjugate(X) y = np.fft.fft(X_conj) x = np.conjugate(y) / N
if not ( np.allclose(X_conj, [10, -2 - 2j, -2, -2 + 2j]) and np.allclose(y, [4, 8, 12, 16]) and np.allclose(x, [1, 2, 3, 4]) ): raise ValueError("The supplied spectrum does not reproduce the specified pipeline.")
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(9.6, 3.8), dpi=100, facecolor="white") ax = fig.add_axes([0, 0, 1, 1]) ax.set_xlim(0, 1) ax.set_ylim(0, 1) ax.axis("off")
ax.text( 0.04, 0.915, "Inverse FFT using the forward fft", fontsize=17, fontweight="semibold", ha="left", va="center" ) ax.text( 0.96, 0.915, r"$N=4$", fontsize=13, ha="right", va="center", color=ink )
identity = ( r"$x_n" r"=\frac{1}{N}\sum_{k=0}^{N-1}X_k\,\omega_N^{+kn}" r"=\frac{1}{N}\,\mathrm{conj}\!\left(" r"\sum_{k=0}^{N-1}\mathrm{conj}(X_k)\,\omega_N^{-kn}\right)" r"=\frac{1}{N}\,\mathrm{conj}\!\left(" r"\mathrm{FFT}(\mathrm{conj}(X))_n\right)$" ) ax.text(0.5, 0.748, identity, ha="center", va="center", fontsize=13) ax.text( 0.5, 0.635, r"$\omega_N=e^{2\pi i/N},\quad n=0,\ldots,N-1$", fontsize=9.5, ha="center", va="center" )
ax.text( 0.5, 0.535, r"Input spectrum: $X=[10,\,-2+2i,\,-2,\,-2-2i]^{\mathsf{T}}$", ha="center", va="center", fontsize=11 )
centers = [0.18, 0.50, 0.82] colors = [blue, teal, ochre] headings = [ "1 Conjugate input", "2 Call forward fft", "3 Conjugate and divide", ] codes = [ "X_conj = X.iter().map(|z| z.conj()).collect()", "fft(&X_conj)", "y.into_iter().map(|z| z.conj() / 4.0)", ]
for center, color, heading in zip(centers, colors, headings): ax.text( center, 0.402, heading, color=color, fontsize=11.5, fontweight="semibold", ha="center", va="center" )
# Keep the longer Rust statement readable without crowding adjacent stages. ax.text( centers[0], 0.305, "X_conj = X.iter()\n .map(|z| z.conj()).collect()", fontfamily="DejaVu Sans Mono", fontsize=8.6, ha="center", va="center", linespacing=1.5 ) ax.text( centers[1], 0.305, codes[1], fontfamily="DejaVu Sans Mono", fontsize=9, ha="center", va="center" ) ax.text( centers[2], 0.305, codes[2], fontfamily="DejaVu Sans Mono", fontsize=8.2, ha="center", va="center" )
outputs = [ r"$[10,\,-2-2i,\,-2,\,-2+2i]$", r"$[4,\,8,\,12,\,16]$", r"$x=[1,\,2,\,3,\,4]$", ] for center, output in zip(centers, outputs): ax.text(center, 0.175, output, fontsize=13, ha="center", va="center")
for left, right in [(0.313, 0.355), (0.635, 0.677)]: ax.add_patch(FancyArrowPatch( (left, 0.175), (right, 0.175), arrowstyle="-|>", mutation_scale=11, linewidth=1.2, color=ink, shrinkA=0, shrinkB=0 ))
ax.text( centers[1], 0.09, "Forward FFT output", fontsize=8.5, ha="center", va="center" ) ax.text( centers[2], 0.09, "Reconstructed signal", fontsize=8.5, ha="center", va="center" )
